Description

 

The Miami HEAT marketing department is hiring an entry-level Front-End Developer with a foundational understanding of Next.js, React, and WordPress. This role primarily focuses on day-to-day website maintenance, content management, and ongoing site optimization. In this role, you will be responsible for keeping HEAT.com and KaseyaCenter.com accurate, performant, ADA-compliant, and optimized for modern AI search engines.

 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: The following are examples of the various functions required. The job requirements are not limited to the items on this list:

Routine Maintenance & Content Updates: Perform daily content updates, publish new content and events, refresh landing page assets, and maintain site accuracy across HEAT.com and KaseyaCenter.com.
AI Search & SEO Visibility: Implement and maintain technical metadata, schema markup, and content structure to optimize website content for AI search visibility and generative answer engines.
Accessibility Compliance: Continuously monitor and audit web pages to ensure full accessibility and ADA compliance.
Site Upkeep & Quality Assurance: Test and debug existing site code, monitor web performance, and verify site functionality across mobile and desktop environments.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional marketing teams and handle additional operational responsibilities as directed by the Web Manager/Developer.
Web Development: Assist the Web Manager/Developer with building reusable code snippets and assembling new webpage layouts or user-facing features as needed.

 

Desired Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

 

Education and/or Experience
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field, along with experience in routine website maintenance and front-end development support.
Content Management Proficiency: Hands-on experience managing digital content and site updates for sports or live events.
Technical Maintenance & Web Skills:
Proficient understanding of WordPress CMS and daily content administration.
Working knowledge of web markup (HTML5, CSS3) and utility frameworks like Tailwind CSS.
Working knowledge of client-side scripting and JavaScript frameworks, with an emphasis on React and Next.js client-side architectures (e.g., client components, client-side data fetching and state caching with libraries like SWR, URL state management, and interactive UI components)
SEO & AEO Fundamentals: Foundational understanding of JSON-LD schema implementation, semantic HTML, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) / AI Search principles.
Browser & Cross-Device QA: Experience using browser developer tools to diagnose page rendering issues, broken layout styles, or console errors on mobile and desktop platforms.
Third-Party Integrations: Familiarity with tracking URL parameter structures and third-party ticketing platforms.
Solid grasp of NBA basketball and Miami HEAT franchise history.
